question: Should Factory Auto prefer an available API key over an existing browser/WorkOS session, potentially changing the displayed account unless users select `web`?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish that the behavior works, but credential precedence is an intentional user-visible provider policy that tests cannot decide.

options.title: Keep API-first Auto
options.body: Adopt the documented API-first behavior and use explicit `web` or `api` source modes for account pinning.

options.title: Keep web-first Auto
options.body: Preserve existing web sessions as the default and use API keys only explicitly or when web authentication is unavailable.

recommendation.title: Keep API-first Auto
recommendation.body: Adopt the documented API-first behavior and use explicit `web` or `api` source modes for account pinning.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is also the dominant contributor and release integrator for the Factory provider paths affected by this policy.
